breaking.change: The ambient particle emitter builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-emitter: sparkles` (or confetti, embers, snow, bubbles, dust, sparks, fireworks) on the element in a document's `<style>`; a rate, `burst <n>`, `for <time>`, `life <time>`, a speed (`120px/s`), a shape, a size and colours override the preset. `none` stops it.

breaking.change: The per-element particle builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-emitter` in a document: `-og-emitter: 40 burst 30 for 1.6s life 1.2s 80px/s 220px/s diamond 6px #ffd166` throws a burst when the element first stands, emits for 1.6 s, each particle living 1.2 s.

Write `-og-burst: <count> [<radius>px] [<colour>] [<time>]` in a `@keyframes` step of the element's animation (`@keyframes land { 60% { -og-burst: 24 48px #ffd166 600ms; } }`); a delay is the animation's `animation-delay`.
Eject the `celebration` component document (`og ui eject celebration`) and use it as `<Celebration kind="levelUp" shots={$shots} value={$level} />`: a new `shots` id plays it again.

breaking.change: The zoomable picture builder is removed.
breaking.fix: In a document, scale the picture by a store (`style:--zoom={$zoom}`, `scale: var(--zoom)`) and keep the zoom from its `onwheel` and `onpinch` events (`onpinch`'s `scale` and centre `x`, `y`); a two-finger scroll of a scroll container is unchanged.

breaking.member: og.ui.nodeGraph, og.ui.NodeGraphDesc, og.ui.NodeGraphResult, og.ui.GraphNode, og.ui.GraphLink, og.ui.GraphNodeState, og.ui.GraphNodeShape
breaking.change: The node graph builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Eject the `node-graph` component document (`og ui eject node-graph`): nodes and links (SVG path data) from stores, `pick` from a node's press, the zoom and pan kept from its `zoom`, `pinch` and `pan` events.

breaking.change: The framed turntable viewport builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<viewport src={$target} camera-controls camera-orbit="0deg 75deg 3m" min-camera-orbit="auto 60deg 1.5m" max-camera-orbit="auto 120deg 6m" bind:cameraOrbit={$orbit} bind:clientWidth={$w} bind:clientHeight={$h}>` in a document (a drag orbits and flings it, the wheel and a pinch zoom, the arrows turn it once focused); show `<Spinner />` until the target has a texture.

breaking.change: The scene viewport builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<viewport src={$target} camera-orbit=… bind:clientWidth={$w} onpointermove={aim}>` in a document; its pointer events carry the ray into its scene, and `camera-controls` orbits it.

breaking.change: The loading spinner builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Use the `spinner` component document (`<Spinner size={28} />`, `og ui eject spinner`).

breaking.change: The effect layer builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-material: shine(…)` (a built-in) or `-og-material: "ui-kits/materials/foil.ogt" 0.7` (a `type ui-material` asset, numbers over its defaults in `param` order) on the element in a document; bind a parameter from a store with `style:--k={$k}` and `var(--k)`, and sweep one with a `@keyframes` of the property.

breaking.change: The meta layer builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `-og-meta: vignette #a00`, `tint <colour>` or `material <material>` (as `-og-material` writes one, a custom asset too) on an element in a document; its strength is the element's `opacity`, and a pulse is a CSS animation of it.
